title: Copy & Clone

writing.exampleCaption: The integer copies; the String would have moved without .clone().
writing.explanation: Types that are cheap and have no destructor can be Copy, so assigning them leaves the original usable. Everything that owns a heap allocation is not Copy, and duplicating it means calling .clone() explicitly — the cost is visible in the source rather than hidden in an assignment.
writing.feedback: Cloning creates a second owned String, so the original binding stays valid.
